project_type: Full-stack monorepo: NestJS (TypeScript) backend in apps/api, Next.js 14 (TypeScript) + Tailwind CSS frontend in apps/web. PostgreSQL 17 + Redis 7 + BullMQ. Docker Compose orchestration. Nginx reverse proxy. Tahap 1 vanilla HTML/JS at repo root stays live and must not be touched.
language: TypeScript throughout (strict mode). Backend: NestJS 10. Frontend: Next.js 14 App Router.
build_system: Docker Compose builds both apps via their individual Dockerfiles. Backend: apps/api/Dockerfile (node:20-alpine, runs prisma migrate deploy then npm run start:prod). Frontend: apps/web/Dockerfile (node:20-alpine, next build). No local build needed — docker compose up handles everything. For local dev: npm install in apps/api and apps/web separately, then npm run start:dev (api) / npm run dev (web).
test_framework: Jest (NestJS default). Test command inside apps/api: npm run test. E2E: npm run test:e2e. No frontend tests in scope for Tahap 2.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `docker compose up --build` from D:\Anti-LinkedIn. 2. All 7 containers start healthy: postgres, redis, backend, frontend, worker, nginx. 3. GET http://192.168.1.20/api/health returns {status:'ok'}. 4. POST http://192.168.1.20/api/auth/register creates a user. 5. POST http://192.168.1.20/api/auth/login returns JWT. 6. GET http://192.168.1.20/api/posts returns paginated feed. 7. http://192.168.1.20 loads Next.js landing page. 8. http://192.168.1.20/app loads 5-tab main app. 9. Tahap 1 files at root are untouched (index.html, app.html, js/, styles/ still exist).
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/api/prisma/migrations/ — generated by `npx prisma migrate dev --name init` inside the api container or locally. Must be committed so the Docker entrypoint can run `prisma migrate deploy`.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine (D:\Anti-LinkedIn). Target server: Ubuntu 192.168.1.20 with Docker already installed. Node.js at C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe locally. All new files go inside apps/ or config files (docker-compose.yml, .env.example, docker/nginx/default.conf) at repo root. NEVER modify: index.html, app.html, js/, styles/, README.md, TECHNICAL-BLUEPRINT.md at repo root.
contribution_requirements: Do not touch Tahap 1 files. Each FEAT must leave docker compose up --build producing a working build. Prisma migrations must be generated and committed. JWT secret and DB passwords come from .env (never hardcoded). bcryptjs used for password hashing (argon2 adds native deps that complicate Alpine builds — use bcryptjs instead).
key_patterns: 1. NestJS modules: each domain (auth, users, posts, reactions, avatars, store, certificates, worker, common) is a separate module with controller + service + dto + entities. 2. Prisma service is a shared singleton in a PrismaModule (apps/api/src/prisma/). 3. Guards: JwtAuthGuard (extends AuthGuard('jwt')) applied globally except public routes decorated with @Public(). 4. Validation: global ValidationPipe with whitelist:true, forbidNonWhitelisted:true. 5. Next.js App Router: server components by default, 'use client' for interactive components. API calls via lib/api.ts using NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL. 6. Tailwind: config in apps/web/tailwind.config.ts, colors match Tahap 1 palette (#F5C542 primary, #F57C00 accent, #172B4D navy, #FAFAFA bg). 7. Docker: multi-stage builds for smaller images. healthcheck on postgres and redis, depends_on with condition: service_healthy on backend/worker. 8. BullMQ worker runs as separate process via apps/api/src/worker/worker.ts entrypoint.
directory_structure: D:\Anti-LinkedIn\ root: index.html, app.html, js/, styles/ (Tahap 1 — DO NOT TOUCH). New structure: apps/api/ (NestJS), apps/web/ (Next.js), docker/nginx/, docker-compose.yml, .env.example. .agents/tasks/ holds artifact files only — never committed to app.
